A. History and Development of the Company
Overview
Our legal and commercial name is BrasilAgro—Companhia Brasileira de Propriedades Agrícolas. We are a corporation ( sociedade por ações ) organized under the laws of Brazil and were incorporated on September 23, 2005. Our principal offices are located at Av. Rebouças, 2942, 6 th floor, São Paulo, SP, 05402-500, Brazil, and our telephone number is +55 11 3035 5350.
We are focused on the acquisition, development and exploration of agricultural properties that we believe possess significant potential for cash flow generation and value appreciation. We seek to transform our acquired properties through investments in infrastructure and technologies which permit cultivation of high value-added crops (soybean, corn, sugarcane and others) and cattle raising and sell our developed properties in order to realize capital gains.
Since our initial public equity offering and listing in Brazil on the B3 stock exchange in April 2006, or the IPO, and the subsequent commencement of our operations until the date hereof, we acquired 18 agricultural properties in six Brazilian states, aggregating 324,542 hectares, of which 212,219 hectares were arable but less than 15% of which were cultivated when acquired and 64,380 hectares were protected by environmental regulation. Since then, seven of our agricultural properties were fully sold and six of our agricultural properties were partly sold, representing in the aggregate a total area of 141,309 hectares. As of June 30, 2026, our portfolio comprised 257,141 hectares (including legal reserve and permanent preservation areas), of which 70,085 hectares were held under rural partnership or lease agreements.
On September 19, 2023, our board of directors approved the increase of our capital stock by R$3,064.36 through the issuance of 306,436 new common shares following the exercise of the Warrants by AB (Holdings) 1 S.A.R.L, in connection with the Merger of Agrifirma. As a result of the exercise of the Warrants, our capital stock was increased to R$1,587,984,600.71, divided into 102,683,444 common shares.
We intend to continue to invest in order to develop and transform our agricultural properties in Brazil, Bolivia and Paraguay. In this regard, we intend to continue to apply for financing with government development banks.
From July 1, 2023 until the date hereof, we completed the following transactions:
●
In September 2026, we sold an area of 2,593 hectares (1,752.7 arable hectares) in the Rio do Meio farm, located in Correntina, Bahia. The price was 425 soybean bags per useful hectare, a total nominal amount of R$96.4 million, or approximately R$55,000 per useful hectare. We also leased another 383.4 arable hectares of the same farm, and the lessee has an option to buy them by March 2028 at the same price per hectare.
●
On March 17, 2026, our then subsidiary Agropecuaria Morotí S.A. (merged into Palmeiras S.A. on April 17, 2026) entered into an agreement to sell 921 hectares (502 arable hectares) of the Marangatu farm (“Marangatu II”), located in Mariscal Estigarribia, Boquerón, Paraguay. The total amount of the sale is US$1.5 million (approximately US$3,000 per arable hectare). Of this amount, US$590 thousand, related to 372 hectares (201 arable hectares), was recognized in the third quarter of fiscal year 2026, and the remaining US$903 thousand, related to 549 hectares (301 arable hectares), is subject to certain conditions precedent.
●
In April 2026, we entered into an agreement to terminate the purchase and sale contract for part of the Rio do Meio farm, in Correntina, State of Bahia, originally signed on September 1, 2021 for the sale of 4,559 hectares (3,212 arable hectares) for 746,579 soybean bags. Following the buyer’s default (the buyer is currently under judicial reorganization), the parties agreed to fully and consensually rescind the contract. Of the total area under the contract, 365.75 arable hectares had already been paid for and transferred to the buyer, and 627.87 arable hectares may still be transferred to the buyer, subject to the conditions set forth in the agreement. Upon implementation of the agreement, we derecognized the related receivables (with a present value of R$47.1 million as of December 31, 2025) and reincorporated the remaining 2,218.5 arable hectares into our portfolio as investment property, recognized at fair value in the amount of R$47.1 million.
●
In August 2025, we entered into a lease agreement for approximately 3,081 hectares in Nova Lacerda and Comodoro, State of Mato Grosso, with a term of 13 years. This lease will enable a significant expansion of our operations.
●
In June 2025, we sold the total area of 17,799 hectares in the Preferência farm, located in the municipality of Baianópolis, in the State of Bahia. The total amount of the sale was 452,342 arrobas of cattle, or R$140.0 million on the transaction date.
●
In September 2024, we sold an area of 190 hectares in the Rio do Meio II farm, located in the municipality of Correntina, in the State of Bahia. The total amount of the sale was 54,053 soybean bags, or R$7,128 million. In May 2025, we sold an area of 660 hectares. The total amount of the sale was 75.454 soybean bags, or R$10,064 on the transaction date.
●
In September 2024, we sold an area of 1,157 hectares in the Alto Taquari IV farm, located in the municipality of Alto Taquari and Araputanga, in the State of Mato Grosso. The total amount of the sale was 1,272,274 soybean bags, or R$189,401 on the transaction date.
●
In August 2024, we acquired Companhia Agrícola Novo Horizonte S.A. The acquired company has a lease agreement for 4,767 hectares in the region of Primavera do Leste, State of Mato Grosso. The value of the transaction was R$36.4 million, and the remaining lease term is 16 years with an average price of 13 soybean bags per hectare.
●
In March 2024, we entered into a lease agreement for approximately 8,160 hectares in Brotas, in the State of São Paulo, to produce sugarcane. This lease will allow us to diversify our revenue by entering the sugar market, in addition to producing ethanol. The lease term is staggered, with 5,060 hectares leased in 2024 and the remainder by 2029.
●
In March 2024, we sold an area of 12,297 hectares (8,757 arable hectares) in the Chaparral farm, located in the municipality of Correntina, in the State of Bahia. The total amount of the sale was 346 soybean bags per arable hectare, or R$415.1 million (approximately R$47,399 per arable hectare).
